title: History reference classification
responsibility: Names evidence and archive references and distinguishes source branches from history and internal refs.

inputs.name: sourceArchiveRef.commit
inputs.description: Tested commit id to append to the source archive prefix; shape is not validated here.

inputs.name: refKind.ref
inputs.description: Full Git reference name to classify by exact evidence/notes names and known prefixes.

outputs.name: sourceArchiveRef
outputs.description: Reference refs/harness/source/ followed by the supplied commit.

outputs.name: refKind
outputs.description: Source, evidence, notes, archive, internal, tag, remote or other classification. Evidence is recognized before the general branch prefix.

outputs.name: historyRefs
outputs.type: { evidence: string; notes: string; archives: string }
outputs.description: Evidence and notes refs plus the source archive wildcard used to select Harness history.
